_readme: Every message the guestbook can show, in one place. Read at runtime by
public/guestbook.php and imported at build time by the Guestbook tab, so a
string lives here once rather than once per runtime. Same arrangement as
contact-messages.json, and for the same reason: those two had drifted.
WIDTH BUDGET: these render on ONE LINE, in a sprite font that does not
wrap. Most of them appear in the description strip under the header, which
is the full width of the stage — so the budget is 1000px. The exceptions
are loadFailed and empty, which are drawn in the entries panel instead and
are held to 480. tests/message-widths.mjs measures every string below
against the real glyph widths in src/font.css and fails if one will not
fit, so you do not have to count characters by eye.
Keys are referenced by name in both runtimes. Renaming one means changing it
in both; changing the text means changing nothing else.
Lines starting with an underscore are ignored by everything that reads this.
expired: Your session expired. Please reload the page.
rateLimited: You have signed too recently. Try again later.
busy: The guestbook is busy. Try again in a moment.
badRequest: That entry could not be processed.
